summary: Describes the correct procedure for incrementally updating the Internet checksum when only part of a packet changes, so it need not be recomputed from scratch. It replaces the description in RFC 1071. It is an implementation technique, not a standard.

eli5.summary: If you change one number in a long sum, you do not redo everything. You just fix the total by the difference.

questions: how to update ip checksum after changing a field
